delivery.outcome: Bare `koru goal` runs `goal -a`, emits target-owned diagnostic evidence, and performs at most one fail-closed agent remediation cycle for GOV-TICKET-001 unless the operator selects `--no-auto-remediate`.
nonGoals: Do not make Goal depend on or invoke Koru
Do not bypass governance, create arbitrary shell remediation, push, merge, tag or publish
Do not auto-remediate unknown diagnostics or retry more than once

architecture.decision: Keep Goal authoritative and place orchestration in Koru: bare `koru goal` captures one `goal -a` result, resolves only target-published GOV diagnostics, launches one existing agent backend for the allowlisted ticket-owner repair by default, then performs one observable retry; a negative flag disables the launch.
interfaceChanges: Add `koru goal` with default one-shot remediation and an explicit `--no-auto-remediate` diagnostic mode
architecture.rollback: Remove the command and supervisor; direct Goal invocation remains unchanged.

validation.evidence: Focused subprocess, diagnostic, launch and retry tests

commands: python -m ruff check src/koru/goal_supervisor.py src/koru/cli_goal.py src/koru/cli.py tests/test_goal_supervisor.py tests/test_cli.py
